Senses.Explanation: The compound marks a test carried through to exposure: to see someone or something through. Zhaozhou Congshen returns from testing the old woman on the road to Mount Wutai and declares that he has seen her through. Xuedou Chongxian and Wansong Xingxiu use the completed formula as a capping verdict. Dahui Zonggao turns it reflexively, telling an interlocutor that the old monk has been seen through by him before striking when he hesitates. Another transmitted version gives Zhaozhou's declaration that he saw the woman through. Wumen Huikai reverses the testing relation by saying the two hermits instead saw Zhaozhou through, and elsewhere preserves Zhaozhou's declaration in the Wutai-woman case. The tester can thus be tested in turn; the verb denotes successful exposure claimed within the encounter, not an infallible external judgment.
Senses.Note: Exact frozen-corpus count: 1,812 hits in 282 files and 277 works. Seven witnesses across six independent works meet the packet floor and cover declaration, capping verdict, reflexive reversal, parallel transmission, and tester reversal.

Occurrences.Kwic: 師歸院謂僧曰。臺山婆子為汝勘破了也
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Compendium of the Five Lamps (五燈會元): Zhaozhou Congshen returns and declares to the community that he has seen the Mount Wutai woman through.

Occurrences.Kwic: 雪竇著語云。勘破了也。一似鐵橛相似。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Blue Cliff Record by Chan Master Foguo Yuanwu (佛果圜悟禪師碧巖錄): Xuedou Chongxian supplies the capping verdict “seen through,” which Yuanwu Keqin raises in commentary.
Book of Serenity by Wansong (萬松老人評唱天童覺和尚頌古從容庵錄): Wansong Xingxiu supplies the completed seeing-through verdict in his commentary.

Occurrences.Kwic: 師云。老僧被爾勘破。僧擬議。師便打。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Dahui Pujue (大慧普覺禪師語錄): Dahui Zonggao says the interlocutor has seen him through, then strikes when the interlocutor hesitates.

Occurrences.Kwic: 州歸院云。婆子被我勘破了也。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Heshang Xutang (虛堂和尚語錄): the raised case quotes Zhaozhou Congshen declaring that he has seen the woman through.

Occurrences.Kwic: 爭奈趙州却被二庵主勘破。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: The Gateless Barrier (無門關): Wumen Huikai reverses the testing relation and says the two hermits saw Zhaozhou Congshen through.

Occurrences.Kwic: 臺山婆子我與爾勘破了也。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: The Gateless Barrier (無門關): Wumen Huikai's case text quotes Zhaozhou Congshen declaring that he has seen the Mount Wutai woman through.
